title: (Bonus) What I know about telepathy
description: This is an archived personal audio journal documenting what I know about telepathy. There's only one more. If you "liked" this episode please let me know. Instructions on how to do so are included in the episode itself! Just recall what it feels like to be with me and then lob thoughts and feelings my way. I'll do my best to reply. Ha. Ha. Ha.
